values.meaning: bonus attack speed from Element of Surprise
duration of Element of Surprise attack speed buff

mechanics.claim: Element of Surprise's attack speed buff does not stack, only refreshes on retrigger.
mechanics.quote: ''Element of Surprise's'' buff does not {{tip|stack}} with itself, only refreshes on subsequent triggers within the duration.

mechanics.claim: A basic attack breaks stealth at the end of the attack windup, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: Stealth requires being idle and undamaged for 1.5 seconds, and is broken by taking non-DoT damage or stealth-breaking actions.
mechanics.quote: '''Teemo''' gains {{tip|invisibility}} after {{fd|1.5}} seconds without moving, taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage, performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}}, {{tip|channel|channeling}}, or being in {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}}.
